**1. The request isn't in the CRM.** I couldn't find DR-9105 in the Northstar CRM discount requests file. The only pending request with these exact figures is **DR-9001**: account CRM-2048 (Acme Manufacturing), NS-500, 15%, list $250,000, net $212,500, raised by Sarah Chen on 2026-09-23, justification "Contract pricing per Acme Master Supply Agreement". Sarah's email to Michael Torres also says "I've logged it in CRM as DR-9001." This may be the same deal under the wrong ID or account. Under the procedure, I decided on DR-9105 as you gave it, not on DR-9001.

**2. The customer.** CRM-2091 is **Acme Industrial Supply Co.** (ERP C-1044, Akron, OH; account owner Zachary Brown). The documents say directly that it "is a different company" from Acme Manufacturing / Acme Mfg. Holdings (CRM-2048, ERP C-1001, Milwaukee).

**3. The product.** NS-500 Industrial Controller, list price $250,000.

**4–5. Contract and pricing exception.** The Acme Master Supply Agreement (ACME-MFG-2025, in force 2025-04-01 to 2028-03-31) is with Acme Mfg. Holdings, doing business as Acme Manufacturing. So is its Schedule B exception (EXC-ACME-NS500-15, up to 15% on NS-500). I found no contract or exception for Acme Industrial Supply. Special terms don't carry over to another company, so the cited contract pricing doesn't cover this customer.

**6–8. Policy and authority.** The Northstar Pricing Policy 2026 applies to this date (2026-01-01 to 2026-12-31). Sarah Chen is an Enterprise Account Executive, so she can approve up to 10%. A discount from 10% to 20% needs the VP Sales, Michael Torres. Even with valid terms, she couldn't approve 15% herself.

**9. Decision.** The request depends on special terms that don't cover this customer, so it needs commercial review. A more senior approver can't fix that.

Before anything else, two things need checking: whether DR-9105 exists at all, and whether this is actually the Acme Manufacturing deal (DR-9001, CRM-2048) entered under the wrong account. If it's the Acme Manufacturing deal, DR-9001 should be decided as its own request. One minor point: CRM-2091's account owner is Zachary Brown, not Sarah.
